title: Snapshots implementation
description: The implementation used for snapshots. Unset to inherit the choice.

title: Agent prompt append
description: Text appended verbatim to every agent's system prompt. Steers every agent.

title: AI role decide
description: Provider and model used for this role. Remove the override to inherit.

title: AI role default
description: Provider and model used for this role. Remove the override to inherit.

title: AI role summarize
description: Provider and model used for this role. Remove the override to inherit.

title: Event retention
description: How long each event namespace's payloads and large content are kept, in days: `{ agent: { payloadDays: 60, contentDays: 14 } }`, over core's defaults (agent 30/14; test, code, collector, effect 90/30). An extension's namespace is kept no longer than its window; core state (snapshot, vcs, effort, …) is kept whole.

title: Extension instances
description: Instances of extension providers, by `<extension>/<instance id>`: `{ enabled, config, provider? }` (the provider's instance config; `provider` names which of the extension's providers an instance with its own id is). Enabling one runs its program once this machine approved it.

title: Extension sources
description: Where an extension's source is when it isn't `.oxplow/extensions/<name>/`: `{ <name>: <folder> }`, relative to the checkout or absolute (`~/` is the home folder). Enables code.

title: Enable oxplow-bundled
description: Whether this extension is enabled. Deployment and permission approval are separate.

title: Enable oxplow-json
description: Whether this extension is enabled. Deployment and permission approval are separate.

title: Enable oxplow-web
description: Whether this extension is enabled. Deployment and permission approval are separate.

title: Enable oxplow-yaml
description: Whether this extension is enabled. Deployment and permission approval are separate.

title: Enable oxtask
description: Whether this extension is enabled. Deployment and permission approval are separate.

title: Enable oxwiki
description: Whether this extension is enabled. Deployment and permission approval are separate.

title: File kinds
description: The project's own file-kind rules, on top of what the enabled extensions declare (`file_kinds:`): `[{ kind: generated, glob: "gen/**" }]`. A kind is lowercase letters, digits and dashes (`ci`, `sensitive`, `lockfile`, …).

title: Generated: exclude
description: Paths oxplow ignores even when `.gitignore` doesn't (watching, snapshots and scans): a single segment (`target`) matches any path component; a repo-relative path (`apps/desktop/dist`) matches that path and what is under it.

title: Generated: include
description: Paths `.gitignore` ignores that oxplow still watches, snapshots and scans, written as for the exclude list.

title: Icon tint
description: Hex colour composited behind the app icon so windows are tellable apart (macOS).

title: Inject session context
description: Inject the session-context block into every agent prompt.

title: Language servers
description: Extra language servers, each `{ languageId, extensions, command, args }`. Runs programs.

title: Metrics
description: Which metrics are on: `use` turns one on (with optional target/warnAt/failAt), `enabled: false` turns an on-by-default one off. Metrics are defined in extensions.

title: Metric detail max per producer
description: Keep per-run detail for only the newest N captures per producer; 0 disables the cap.

title: Metric detail retention days
description: Compact per-run detail older than this many days; 0 disables.

title: Metric retention days
description: Metric-capture retention in days; 0 (default) keeps everything.

title: Project name
description: Display name; defaults to the project directory's basename.

title: Replacements
description: Whose component shows for a replaceable core sub-component, by target: `{ task.board: task-views, vcs.history.graph: oxplow }` — an extension replacing it, or `oxplow` for oxplow's own. Unlisted, the only extension replacing it shows (several: oxplow's own); a bound target (`task.detail.state`) shows its provider's extension's, and may only be set to `oxplow`.

title: Script workers at once
description: How many script workers run at once, across the host; a run past it waits for a slot. Default: 4, or fewer on a machine with fewer cores.

title: Script worker memory (MiB)
description: The most memory one script worker may use before it is stopped, in MiB.

title: Snapshot max file bytes
description: Largest file snapshotted by content; bigger files get a stat-only entry.

title: Snapshot retention days
description: File-snapshot retention in days; 0 disables pruning.

title: Testing hint for agents
description: Text added to every agent's system prompt about testing: which command to run, what coverage to meet.

title: Analysis run patterns
description: Extra command substrings that count as a static-analysis run, on top of the built-in ones (cargo clippy, eslint, ruff, …).

title: Test command
description: The command that runs the project's whole test suite.

title: Fast test command
description: A quicker test command for the inner loop, when the project has one.

title: Test run patterns
description: Extra command substrings that count as a test run, on top of the built-in ones (pytest, cargo test, jest, …).

title: Test paths
description: Globs (repo-relative) naming test files, on top of the built-in conventions (`.test.` and `.spec.` files, `tests/` folders, …): `spec/**`.
